http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26275v1.summary: dLoop restructures a pretrained diffusion language model into a looped architecture that reapplies a shared block before token commitment, reporting top or tied-top accuracy on GSM8K, MATH, MBPP and HumanEval.

http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26358v1.summary: A technical report introducing Beam, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 501.3B total and 23.4B active parameters for coding, reasoning, and agentic tasks, with a 1M-token context window and a large-scale asynchronous RL post-training run.

http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26624v1.summary: PlayCraft is an automated framework in which a vision-based agent plays a game, reports its experience, and a crafter agent revises the game for mastery, yielding larger learning gains and steeper learning slopes than initial games in most cases.
